# Review: podiumd release and upgrade docs

## Upgrade guide (`docs/_UPGRADE_PATHS/<from>-to-<to>-upgrade.md`)

- It has the runbook sections A to F: once per cluster, once per values
  repository, per environment before the deploy day, the deploy run, after
  the deploy, rollback. A section with nothing to do says "Nothing for this
  hop." and its Checklist box says so too.
- A step says when it runs relative to `helm upgrade`, whether it can run
  twice, what state a failure leaves, and which rights it needs. `kubectl`
  commands pass `--context`.
- "Changes that need no action" is one line per change. Anything that needs a
  command, an edit or a decision belongs in A to F instead.
- "Component versions" and "Changes" are generated by the release tooling.
  Under "Changes", only component version changes are level-3 sections; other
  changes get their own level-2 section. A hand-written note under a
  component links a step and does not repeat it.
- The Reference part holds detail for steps that link to it. No test logs,
  dated counts or reasoning: those belong in the commit message.

## Values deltas (`docs/_UPGRADE_PATHS/<from>-to-<to>-values-deltas.md`)

- Config only: what changes in a gemeente's `podiumd.yml`,
  `services-gateway.yml` and `ssl-gateway.yml`. Prose goes in the upgrade
  guide.
- One `## <component> <old> → <new> (chart …)` section per component, and no
  section for a pure version bump. The heading is generated.
- Each section has one lead sentence, then YAML annotated in place with
  `# new`, `# was …`, `# remove`, `# remove the whole block`. Only keys that
  environments actually set.

## Generated files

- `docs/images/images-<version>.yaml` lists only images that are new or
  changed against the previous release, with the same tag and digest as
  `values.yaml`.
- `etc/release-table.csv` is generated. Flag a hand edit that does not match
  a regenerated file.
